semantics: Documentation graphs, not executable n8n workflows. Edges are process/data-flow compositions supported by references; planned edges are proposals.
title: Customer support
subtitle: Care tickets, conversations, attachments, mailbox and authenticated replies

nodes.label: Open support conversation
nodes.description: Customer care interface sends tickets, reads conversations and uploads attachments.

nodes.label: Care / support API
nodes.description: Authenticated care path creates structured tickets. /api/v1/support is a separate legacy ticket path.

nodes.label: Authenticate and validate
nodes.description: Care viewer must be signed in; schema and rate limit apply to mutations.

nodes.label: Create care ticket
nodes.description: Record request and initial support conversation; order-linked requests validate ownership.

nodes.label: Tickets and messages
nodes.description: tickets, support_conversations, support_messages and attachment metadata store conversation state.

nodes.label: Support inbox and replies
nodes.description: Owner/support inbox manages replies, status and mail thread linkage.

nodes.label: Resend / Gmail mailbox
nodes.description: Gmail OAuth mailbox sync and Resend outbound delivery are implemented code paths. Runtime configuration and connectivity are Unverified.

nodes.label: Updated conversation
nodes.description: Customer sees support replies; realtime notifications have a separate transport service.

nodes.label: Request failed
nodes.description: Validation, access, conflict or service errors are returned to the caller. Status and error shape depend on the specific route.

nodes.label: Show error / retry
nodes.description: Failure end state. Caller receives the actual error; a retry may be offered by the UI.

notes: Source implementation is documented; deployed configuration and provider connectivity are not verified.
Care tickets and legacy support_tickets are distinct collections. Conversation IDs encode the source collection; do not conflate them.
